_note: Catalogue metadata mirrored from the Google Sheet 'LMS Project Assets/Course_structure'. Rebuilt on each sync; a blank Keywords cell keeps the existing value. Powers the catalogue search + course type. Edit the sheet to change it.

CO0001.title: Flowcode and E-blocks 3 CPD Course
CO0001.description: A continuing professional development course that brings teachers and trainers up to speed with Flowcode and the E-blocks 3 hardware. Work through flowchart-based programming and hands-on embedded exercises ready to take straight back into the classroom.

CO0002.title: Introduction to Microcontrollers
CO0002.description: A comprehensive introduction to microcontrollers and embedded systems using Flowcode. Builds from first principles through inputs, outputs and programming to complete working projects.

CO0003.title: Digital Techniques for Aviation Technicians
CO0003.description: Covers the digital electronics and microcontroller techniques aviation technicians need, mapped to EASA Part-66 module requirements. Combines logic fundamentals with practical, avionics-focused exercises.

CO0004.title: Microcontrollers for T-Levels
CO0004.description: A full microcontrollers and embedded systems course aligned to T-Level engineering qualifications, taking students from the basics through to applied programming projects.

CP0507.title: Motors and Microcontrollers
CP0507.description: A worksheet pack on driving and controlling motors with microcontrollers — DC, stepper and servo motors, motor-control circuits and actuator projects.

CP1972.title: Sensors and Microcontrollers
CP1972.description: A worksheet pack exploring how microcontrollers read the world through sensors — analog and digital inputs, temperature and light sensing, and data acquisition.

CP2563.title: Microcontrollers for T-Levels
CP2563.description: A curriculum worksheet pack supporting the T-Level microcontrollers units, with ready-to-use embedded systems exercises for the classroom.

CP4807.title: Introduction to Microcontrollers
CP4807.description: A curriculum worksheet pack introducing microcontrollers and embedded systems from the ground up — beginner-friendly exercises covering the core fundamentals.

CP7244.title: Digital Techniques for Aviation Technicians
CP7244.description: A curriculum worksheet pack covering digital techniques for aviation technicians, with avionics-focused exercises aligned to EASA Part-66 study.
